source: NASA CORAL / PRISM Benthic Cover L2/RBEN
historical_data_note: CORAL campaign observations are historical (2016-2017); do not present them as current or real-time reef health.
probability_note: coral, algae and sand are per-pixel class probabilities from 0 to 1; they are not direct diagnoses of coral health or mortality.
statistics_note: Counts, minimum, mean and maximum use all valid pixels. Median is estimated from a regular spatial sample.
quality_note: A benthic pixel is valid when coral, algae and sand are all finite and within their declared valid ranges. Masked/invalid pixels are data-availability gaps, not evidence of ecological degradation.
spatial_validity_note: spatial_validity_sample.csv is a regular geospatial sample of coordinates with valid navigation values. It includes both valid and masked/invalid benthic classifications to visualize data coverage.
